text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, 1st place! V-sign! The audience 
looked so happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Did you see Ma-san from the grocery store 
and the parking lot guard shouting 
'Banzai!'?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm definitely, abso-lutely gonna 
take 1st place next time too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because I think doing that will make us 
feel even more happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I think so too! I haven't had nearly 
enough running yet!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Which race should we enter next! Whatever 
it is, I'm taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Leave it to the great Urara-sama~!
